newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Frontier seeks to raise A$1.024 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Frontier seeks to raise A$1.024 mln.

text.p: Frontier Petroleum NL said on Friday it would seek to raise A$1.024 million through a placement of 6.21 million ordinary shares in part to fund drilling work in Vietnam.
The placement represents 10 percent of the existing issued shares and the shares are priced at 16.5 Australian cents each, Frontier said.
The capital raising is earmarked for funding of the D14-3 appraisal well and to provide ongoing working capital to begin the company's programme of diversification, it said.
Frontier holds a 20 percent interest in Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd, which is conducting exploration work on oil and gas prospects in Vietnam's Hanoi Basin.
Anzoil (Asia) is 80 percent owned by Anzoil Ltd.
Frontier managing director Phil Lawry earlier this year said Frontier was looking to expand into oil production in Indonesia.
